graph_diagnosis.summary: The graph links quantitative tightening, balance-sheet liquidity, and money-supply momentum.
weaknesses: The direct M2 mechanism is simplified.
Some causal links repeat identical evidence.

search_factors.why_search: Balance-sheet runoff can reduce system liquidity.
SOMA balances provide an observable runoff transmission measure.
Liquidity demand can offset the effect of runoff.
An early end to tightening would alter liquidity conditions.

checkpoints.mechanism: Balance-sheet runoff is intended to reduce system liquidity.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Federal Reserve implementation details and runoff caps.
checkpoints.contradiction_signal: Runoff pauses or balance sheet expands.

checkpoints.mechanism: Runoff reduces the Federal Reserve securities portfolio and system liquidity.
Higher liquidity demand can counteract the restrictive effect of runoff.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Reserve demand, funding stress, or credit indicators.

checkpoints.mechanism: A policy interruption could lessen the expected liquidity restraint.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: Policy announcements or credible implementation changes.

checkpoints.mechanism: Liquidity contraction can slow M2 momentum unless offset by demand or policy changes.
checkpoints.evidence_requirement: M2 release, bank deposits, and balance-sheet liquidity data.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Continued runoff can reduce liquidity and slow money-supply momentum.
failure_conditions: Runoff is offset by liquidity facilities.

causal_paths.generalized_mechanism: Liquidity demand can blunt the restrictive transmission from runoff to money supply.
failure_conditions: Demand does not affect deposits or credit.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Liquidity demand offsets runoff and supports money-supply momentum.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Deposit and credit growth stay firm despite lower SOMA balances.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: Tightening ends earlier than expected and eases liquidity restraint.
alternative_hypotheses.discriminating_evidence: Federal Reserve communications alter the runoff path.

forecast_audit_questions: Is quantitative tightening still being implemented?
Do SOMA balances show continuing runoff?
Do deposit and credit data corroborate the inferred M2 momentum?
